notes:
Prospect snapshot: mid-market analytics product (SaaS) focused on enterprise customers across EU.
- Team: product org ~25 engineers, ML infra lead (Luca Ferrer), CTO (Elena Morales).
- Primary goal: replace slow lexical search with embeddings-based semantic search and improve support agent resolution time.
- Targets: user-facing search latency <= 60ms p95 for EU region; embedding throughput ~200 qps for search index updates; cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for Dedicated if it guarantees residency + latency.
- Deployment preference: Start Hosted API in eu-west region for fast proof-of-concept. If POC meets SLA, move to Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) in eu-west-2 with VPC peering.
- Data residency nuance: customer data for EU-only customers must be stored and processed within EU ("no PII leaving EU" — quote from CTO). For global customers they want multi-region routing, but with anonymization/obfuscation before any cross-region fallback.
- Latency tradeoffs discussed: Dedicated in-EU gives best p95; Hosted API in single EU region acceptable for pilot; multi-region routing (EU primary, fallback US) needs clear SLA and proof of anonymization.
- POC plan: Redwood to provide sample throughput/latency benchmarks on the model family preferred (LLMs: open-llama-variants + quantized 4bit options), include KV-cache and batching configs. Include monitoring hooks from Redwood Console for token cost breakdown.
- Security asks: SOC2 attestations, SSO (SAML + OIDC), keys in customer KMS, audit logs retention for 12 months, DPA + EU data residency addendum.
- Quote from CTO: "We need a predictable inference cost and absolute clarity on where data lives. If you can prove EU-only residency and sub-60ms p95, Dedicated is a go."
- Integration notes: Backend uses Kubernetes + internal API gateway; engineering estimates 3-4wk integration for Hosted API, 6-8wk for Dedicated with networking/legal signoffs.
- Internal politics: Product team driving technical eval; Legal and Security heavy on residency. Procurement likely to require pricing guarantees for first-year commit.
- Risks: If Redwood's EU region lacks sufficient capacity during peak, they will escalate to support and may request guaranteed burst capacity.
- Stubs/links: Fireflies ff_20241105_9c7a2, drive:/redwood/proposals/velacrest-poc-v1.pdf, RDW-5123 (asking about EU region capacity).
